Thanks for letting us know. Send over the invoice number (or a copy) and I'll take a look at the charge you don't recognise - if it's a billing error, we can correct it directly. I'll also follow up separately on the framework pricing and the excavator availability you asked about earlier.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
